name: Autumn Rail
source:
When returning home from the grocer's one quiet evening, Tera is taken away to Sylvan Station, a place you won’t find on any route or map. Amidst the wither and rot of the station, she meets another passenger who warns her of horrors impending and urges her to run. The night of terror is about to begin...

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4007780/Autumn_Rail/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
在一个安静的夜晚从杂货店回家时，泰拉被带到了西尔万车站，一个你在任何路线或地图上都找不到的地方。在车站的枯萎和腐烂中，她遇到了另一名乘客，他警告她即将发生的恐怖事件并敦促她逃跑。恐怖之夜即将开始……

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4007780/Autumn_Rail/]Steam[/url]]
